text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond has become a Derby 
Umamusume. However, she regrets spending 
the whole race worrying about her shoes 
when nothing was actually wrong.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond lamented that she had let 
the jinx get to her the moment she worried 
about her shoes. She couldn't forgive 
herself for that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She vows to hone her overwhelming strength 
before the Kikuka-sho and prove she can 
overcome the jinx.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At a café on the way home, you overhear a 
passionate conversation. It seems fans 
cheering on Kitasan Black are deeply moved 
by her hard work and dedication.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond felt that Kitasan Black had 
pulled ahead of her. She knew she had to 
become someone worthy of being her rival.
